typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		TRACKING_ID as string,
		MCE_CLAIM_ID as string,
		FORM_TYPE as string,
		BILL_TYPE as string,
		CLAIM_STATUS as string,
		CLAIM_REASON as string,
		CLAIM_PROV_ID as string,
		CLAIM_MEM_ID as string,
		PAT_CTRL_NUM as string,
		HEADER_BILLED_AMT as string,
		STATUS_DETAIL_LINE as string,
		REASON_DETAIL_LINE as string,
		CLAIM_START_DT as string,
		CLAIM_END_DT as string,
		CLAIM_PAID_AMT as string,
		CLAIM_LINE_NUM as string,
		CLAIM_SERV_CODE as string,
		MOD_CODE1 as string,
		MOD_CODE2 as string,
		REV_CODE as string,
		SERV_UNITS as string,
		CLAIM_DETAIL_AMT as string,
		CLAIM_DETAIL_PAID_AMT as string,
		REASON_FOR_REJECTION as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FFStateResponseFileInbound
FFStateResponseFileInbound derive(RunLogID = $RunLogID_StateResponse,
		CLAIM_DETAIL_PAID_AMT_Clean = iif(length(trim(replace(replace(CLAIM_DETAIL_PAID_AMT, toString('\r'), toString('')), toString('\n'), toString('')))) == 0, toString(null()), trim(replace(replace(CLAIM_DETAIL_PAID_AMT, toString('\r'), toString('')), toString('\n'), toString(''))))) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn split(left(TRACKING_ID, 8) == 'REJECTED' || left(TRACKING_ID, 8) == 'ACCEPTED', disjoint: true) ~> ConditionalSplit@(Trailer,ConditionalSplitDefaultOutput)
ConditionalSplit@Trailer sink(input(
		RunLogID as integer,
		StateResponse_Status as string,
		Record_Count as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		RunLogID,
		StateResponse_Status = TRACKING_ID,
		Record_Count = MCE_CLAIM_ID)) ~> OLEDBOHCHPendedPaidClaimsTrailerResponse
ConditionalSplit@ConditionalSplitDefaultOutput sink(input(
		RunLogID as integer,
		CLAIM_REASON as string,
		CLAIM_DETAIL_PAID_AMT as integer,
		CLAIM_LINE_NUM as integer,
		SERV_UNITS as integer,
		CLAIM_START_DT as string,
		PAT_CTRL_NUM as string,
		HEADER_BILLED_AMT as integer,
		CLAIM_PROV_ID as string,
		REV_CODE as string,
		CLAIM_STATUS as string,
		MOD_CODE2 as string,
		CLAIM_SERV_CODE as string,
		CLAIM_MEM_ID as string,
		STATUS_DETAIL_LINE as string,
		REASON_FOR_REJECTION as string,
		FORM_TYPE as string,
		MOD_CODE1 as string,
		TRACKING_ID as string,
		BILL_TYPE as string,
		CLAIM_END_DT as string,
		CLAIM_PAID_AMT as integer,
		MCE_CLAIM_ID as string,
		REASON_DETAIL_LINE as string,
		CLAIM_DETAIL_AMT as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		RunLogID,
		CLAIM_REASON,
		CLAIM_DETAIL_PAID_AMT = CLAIM_DETAIL_PAID_AMT_Clean,
		CLAIM_LINE_NUM,
		SERV_UNITS,
		CLAIM_START_DT,
		PAT_CTRL_NUM,
		HEADER_BILLED_AMT,
		CLAIM_PROV_ID,
		REV_CODE,
		CLAIM_STATUS,
		MOD_CODE2,
		CLAIM_SERV_CODE,
		CLAIM_MEM_ID,
		STATUS_DETAIL_LINE,
		REASON_FOR_REJECTION,
		FORM_TYPE,
		MOD_CODE1,
		TRACKING_ID,
		BILL_TYPE,
		CLAIM_END_DT,
		CLAIM_PAID_AMT,
		MCE_CLAIM_ID,
		REASON_DETAIL_LINE,
		CLAIM_DETAIL_AMT)) ~> OLEDBOHCHPendedPaidClaimsDetailResponse
